itinerary.title: South goa sightseen
itinerary.description:
SOUTH GOA SIGHTSEEING:-
Miramar beach: A bustling area within the capital Panjim, Miramar centres on its namesake beach, a palm-lined strip where shacks sell local fashion, jewellery, and food. Dolphin sightseeing by boat also at Miramar beach (extra charges)
Dona Pola beach: Dona Paula, named for a Portuguese romantic heroine popular in local folklore, is an affluent area at the mouth of the Zuari River known for its ocean views. Dona Paula View Point is a lookout and promenade, home to Baroness von Leistner’s 1969 “Image of India” statue.
Old goa church: The Basilica of Bom Jesus is a Roman Catholic basilica located in Goa, India, and is part of the Churches and convents of Goa UNESCO World Heritage Site. The basilica is located in Old Goa, former capital of Portuguese India, and holds the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier
Se cathedral church: The Sé Cathedral de Santa Catarina, known as Se Cathedral, is the cathedral of the Latin Rite Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Goa and Daman and the seat of the Patriarch of the East Indies. It is part of the World Heritage Site, Churches and convents of Goa located in Old Goa, India.
Wax museum: Old Goa is the home to India's second wax museum. Each figurine is carefully sculpted of paraffin wax; the hair used is natural, although the eyes and teeth are artificial.
The museum has over 30 life-size, statues of famous personalities of Indian culture, heritage and religion. One of the main attractions is the sculpting of the 'last supper' which is 22 feet in length and weights 500 kilos. A guide talks you through the statues at the museum, and explains who the statues are of, what they represent and how long it took to make the sculpture. The guided tour is in English and Hindi. Other main attractions include Mahatma Gandhi, Radha Krishna and Bethlehem. There is a statue called 'say no to drugs' which shows you the side effects of taking drugs and this really brings the concept to life. The is a small gift shop where one can purchase candles of various designs and shapes and smells.
Mangeshi Temple: Shri Mangesh temple is located at Mangeshi Village in Priol, Ponda taluk, Goa. It is at a distance of 1 km from Mardol close to Nagueshi, 21 km from Panaji the capital of Goa, and 26 km from Margao. H.H.Shrimad Swamiji of Shri Kavale Math is Spiritual head Of Shri Manguesh Saunsthan Mangeshi.
St Agustin Tower: Church of St. Augustine is a ruined church complex located in Old Goa. The church was completed in 1602 and is part of the World Heritage Site, Churches and convents of Goa.
Duration: 08 Hours

[About Shimla-The British Empire may have ceased to exist, but its echo lingers on in Shimla (2205m). As the Summer Capital of the British in India, Shimla was the country's focus for the better part of every year and now, is the state capital of Himachal Pradesh. Today, it has well developed facilities, easy accessibility and numerous attractions making it one of India's most popular hill destinations. Situated in the lower ranges of the Himalayan Mountains, it is surrounded by pine deodar, oak and rhododendron forests. Towards the north lie the snow-covered high-ranges, while the valleys breathe whispering streams and swaying fields. Within the town are host of splendid colonial edifices, quaint cottages and charming walks. Shimla offers a variety of shopping, sport and entertainment activities.]

itinerary.title: Arrival Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive to Srinagar meet and Greet on Arrival. Our representative will meet you to pick you up and transfer to Hotel. Complete day free leisure in the evening. Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Sonmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Morning breakfast and proceed to the Hotel for a full day tour of Sonamarg (Meadows of Gold), it has sheer scenic splendour. The very way-a Ametalled road snakes through massive mountains laden with forests and firs. After a breath-taking journey from Srinagar you come across River Sindh that is abounded with trout & Mahseer. Onwards the valley opens up to a meadow. Ponies can be hired for a trip up to Thajiwas glacier ; a major attraction during the summer months.
Sonamarg's importance lies in the fact that it is the last halt on the Kashmir side for the drive from Srinagar to Leh. You will be fascinated to see Snowy Mountains Magar a cerulean sky against its backdrop. Return to Srinagar for overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Doodhpathri - Srinagar
itinerary.description: Doodhpathri Valley of milk, located in Budgam district, lies in a bowl shaped valley in Pir Panjal Range. It’s an alpine valley covered with snow-clad mountains. After some quiet and peaceful time at Doodhpathri, be back to Srinagar for overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar -Gulmarg
itinerary.description: After breakfast check out from the Hotel & proceed to Gulmarg . On arrival in Gulmarg check-in Hotel .Gulmarg is also known as “Meadow Of Flowers “ & has a famous Golf course during summer (which is one if the highest 18-holes golf courses in the world) & Ski Resort during winter.One can have a gondola (cable car) ride from Gulmarg to Khilanmarg(own cost) to have a real view of the natural beauty of the summer and full snow view in winter. You can have a pony ride in the open fields to seven springs (own cost) and to a lake, which remains frozen until June. After free drive , Overnight stay in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg To Pahalgam
itinerary.description: After breakfast check –out from the hotel & proceed to pahalgam”VILLAGE OF SHEPHERDS “ enroute visiting the world famous Saffron growing fields , Awantipura ruins (9th century ) & Martand Temple (sun temple). Pahalgam is famous for the Indian film industry, some trekking routes & also base camp for Amarnath pilgrimage. Dinner & overnight stay in Pahalgam hotel.

itinerary.title: PAHALGAM sightseen
itinerary.description: After breakfast checkout from hotel,and proceed to pahalgam sightseen. We can go to chandanwari, Betab valley & Aru (own cost) has a fine Meadows of Picturesque scenery & starting point of trekking of (Liddarwat , Kolahoi Glacier , Tarsar Lake). After Sightseen, proceed to Srinagar , overnight stay at Srinagar hotel.

itinerary.title: SRINAGAR sightseen
itinerary.description: Morning after breakfast Srinagar Sightseen of famous mughal gardens visiting Nishat ( the garden of pleasure) and shalimar Bagh (abode of love) Cheshma Shahi ,Shankaracharya Temple in the evening enjoy shikara Ride on Dal Lake the beauty that god has graced this city which is often compared to venice. You will get a view of some very interesting places around the lake overnight stay at Srinagar Hotel. Breakfast | Dinner |

itinerary.description: On arrival, meet our assistance at Cochin Airport or Railway Station anproceed to Munnar. On your way visit tea and spice plantations, Cheeyappara waterfalls, view point etc. Arrive Munnar and check in your hotel. Rest of the day free for your own activities. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for Munnar full day Sightseeing–Anayirangal Dam, Mattupetty Dam, Echo point, Rajamalai–where we have ERAVIKULAM National Park, you could find NILGIRITHAR, an endangered species. Anamudi the highest peak in South Indiais situatedin the southern region of the park. Overnight at hotel in Munnar..

itinerary.title: Munnar - Thekkady (Aprox.110 Km)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed to thekkady and check in to hotel & relax. Afternoon, proceed for sightseeing – The Periyar wildlife sanctuary is thick evergreen forest, declared a Tiger Reserve in1978.The splendid artificial lake formed by the Mullaperiyar Dam across the Periyar River adds to the charm of the park.
You can also do a thing in Thekkady like -Boat cruises on the Periyar Lake, visit cardamom, pepper, tea & coffee plantation. Overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Thekkady - Alleppey (Aprox. 139 Km)
itinerary.description: After breakfast proceed to Alleppey, where you will be booked to stay overnight on the Hotel. While sailing down a maze of canals one sees different scenes from the villages, paddy fields, coconut palms, fisherman and local life. The cool breeze from the Lake make you sleep early in the night after anchoring in a fancy place. Overnight at Hotel.

itinerary.title: ALLEPPY - kovalam(APROX.160KM)
itinerary.description: After Breakfast, check out and Proceeding to Kovalam beach; the international beach destination of Kerala often called as the Paradise of South. Kovalam is extremely popular among westerners due to shallow waters and low tidal waves. It is also one of the oldest tourist enclaves in India, which known among tourist circuit right in 1930s. The larger of the beach and the most popular is called Lighthouse Beach. On arrival check in to the resort later spends time at the beach. Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: kovalam - kanyakumari (APROX.100KM)
itinerary.description: After Breakfast proceed to Kanyakumari; The southernmost tip of Indian subcontinent also a fantastic tourist spot with the specialty as three major sea joints together there (Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean and Bay of Bengal). a holy place for Hindu Pilgrims too. Kanyakumari represents the site where the spiritual leader Swami Vivekananda spent days in meditation upon a rock off of the coast. on the way visit Suchindram temple then arrival & check-in to the hotel then Proceeding for Sightseeing visit Devi Kanyakumari Temple, Vivekananda rock Memorial temple, Kanyakumari Gandhi Mandapam, Kanyakumari beach and Kanyakumari Gandhi Mandapam (3 Oceans Joining) are some of the sightseeing attractions in Kanyakumari. Back to Hotel and Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: kovalam - trivandrum (APROX.24KM)
itinerary.description: After breakfast proceed for sightseeing of Trivandrum; capital City of Kerala. Visit Padmanabhaswami Temple (Morning Darshan up to 12 pm, Evening 5 pm to 7.30pm) Then proceeding to Kuthiramalika palace, Sree Chithra Art Gallery, Napier Museum, Zoo, Planetarium (Closed on Mondays) Veli Tourist Village later Shangumugham beach. Etc Later Proceed to Trivandrum Airport /Railway station for your Departure Journey. End Of tour service Back to home with sweet & everlasting memories.

Also, visit JaswantThada - an imposing marble cenotaph built in memory of Maharaja Jaswant Singh II around 1899. Return back to your hotel for dinner.Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur To Jaiselmar Via Nakkoda - Welcome To The Golden City

Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing In Jaisalmer - Travel To The Shimmering 'Golden City' Of Rajasthan
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you can proceed to uncover the secrets hidden behind the Golden Sands of the Thar Desert in Jaisalmer. You can visit the golden Jaisalmer Fort that looks like it has just risen from the sands with its golden limestone walls. And then, you can proceed to marvel at the beautiful royal Havelis including Patwon-Ki-Haveli, Nathmal-Ki-Haveli, and Salim Singh-Ki-Haveli that speaks of the royal past. Dating back from the 12th to 15th century, these Havelis feature exquisite carvings and filigree work. After experiencing the stunning architectural marvels you can take a short stopover at the beautiful Gadisar Lake that was once the only source of water in Jaisalmer. After a wonderful camel safari, the rest of the day is at leisure and you are free to explore the colorful markets and fairs. Once you are done exploring the markets, return back to the hotel for dinner. Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Jaislmer To Jodhpurs Sightseeing - Visit To One Of The Strongest Forts In India

In the evening, take a stroll around the Umaid public garden or shastri circle. Return to the hotel for dinner. overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Arrival At Jaipur - Welcome Tothe 'Pink City Of India'
itinerary.description: Reach Jaipur, where a representative will help you get transferred to the hotel. On reaching the hotel, complete the check-in process and take some rest.Once ready, you can depart for a sightseeing tour of Jaipur. You can explore the rich history of Jaipur as you proceed to visit the City Palace and Museum along with Jantar Mantar, which is a heritage site with fixed instruments for making astronomical observations. In the evening, you can proceed for a photo stop at Hawa Mahal and also opt to explore the nearby markets. Don't forget to visit Albert Hall where you can roam around and savor delicious street food. Then you can visit the famous Moti Doongri Ganesh Temple located on the hilltop and the beautiful Birla Mandir that's made solely of white marble. Later in the evening, you can proceed back to your hotel. Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing In Jaipur
itinerary.description: Explore Amber Fort’s Sheesh Mahal, a Heart-Throb of Bollywood Films.Have a hearty breakfast before embarking on the full-day sightseeing tour to Jaipur.In the morning you can visit the Nahargarh Fort that offers some of the most stunning views of sunrise along with a panoramic view of all of Jaipur in all its splendor.After you are done exploring the beauty of Nahargarh Fort, you can proceed to Jaigarh Fort.Jaigarh houses the massive 18th-century cannon, Jaivana Cannon, a projectile of which made a small lake in Chaksu after traveling approx. 35 Km.Then you can visit the grand Amber Fort and Palace cradled on the top of the Aravali Hill overlooking the Pink City of Jaipur.Here, you can take an Elephant Safari to the top of the Amber Fort and then visit the beautiful Sheesh Mahal where Bollywood legendary movie "Mughal-E-Azam's" song "Jab Pyar Kiya To Darna Kya" was shot.Later in the evening, you can visit the traditional shopping mall where you can shop for beautiful souvenirs.Return back to the hotel in Jaipur for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jaipur To Jodhpur - Home To The Impregnable Mehrangarh Fort
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning and then get ready to transfer to Jodhpur. On reaching the hotel, complete the check-in process and take some rest. Once ready, you can proceed to explore the stunning blue city of Jodhpur.You can visit the beautiful Umaid Bhavan Palace, which is built on a vast 26 acres and is one of the world's largest private residences.Then you can proceed to the majestic Mehrangarh Fort that stands on a perpendicular cliff, four hundred feet above the skyline of Jodhpur.You can also visit the beautiful memorial made in marble, the Jaswant Thada, often described as the “Taj Mahal of Marwar”. Later in the evening, return back to the hotel in Jodhpur for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur To Jaisalmer - Travel To The Shimmering 'Golden City' Of Rajasthan Jaiselmer
itinerary.description: Start your next day with a delicious breakfast then get ready to transfer to Jaisalmer, also known as the Golden City. Take a short stopover at the Jaisalmer War Memorial, which honors the contributions and sacrifices of war heroes, and also traces the evolution of the Indian Army. On arrival in Jaisalmer, check in to your hotel and take some rest. The rest of the day is at leisure and you are free to explore the colorful markets and fairs. Once you are done exploring the markets, return back to the hotel. Overnight stay at the hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing In Jaisalmer - Explore The Secrets Hidden Behind The Beautiful Sand Dunes
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you can proceed to uncover the secrets hidden behind the Golden Sands of the Thar Desert in Jaisalmer. You can visit the golden Jaisalmer Fort that looks like it has just risen from the sands with its golden limestone walls. And then, you can proceed to marvel at the beautiful royal Havelis including Patwon-Ki-Haveli, Nathmal-Ki-Haveli, and Salim Singh-Ki-Haveli that speaks of the royal past. Dating back from the 12th to 15th century, these Havelis feature exquisite carvings and filigree work. After experiencing the stunning architectural marvels you can take a short stopover at the beautiful Gadisar Lake that was once the only source of water in Jaisalmer. You can then depart for a camel ride to the beautiful Sam Sand Dunes overlooking a spectacular sunset. After a wonderful camel safari, you can proceed to check in to the desert camps and enjoy folk performances by the locals while enjoying a bonfire. Have a scrumptious and authentic Rajasthani meal. Overnight stay at the Desert Camp in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer - Bikaner - Witness The Process Of Cancel Breeding
itinerary.description: Wake up in the morning, have a delightful breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Upon reaching Bikaner, check-in at a pre-booked hotel and rest for some time. Visit Junagarh Fort, one of the most decorated forts in India built on a high rock and has lower ramparts and towers. Further visit Karni Mata Temple and the Camel- Breeding farm, Asia's biggest Camel breeding farm to watch different breeds of Camels. In the evening, visit local temples and roam around in the local markets and try world famous bikaneri bhujia. Return back to your hotel for scrumptious dinner. Overnight stay in Bikaner.

itinerary.title: Bikaner To Jaipur And Departure - End Of Trip With A Bag Full Of Life Time Memories

Check out from the desert camps after packing your bags along with a bundle of memories. You can then proceed back towards Jaipur. Conclude the tour with beautiful memories on reaching your desired destination in Jaipur for your onward journey.
